title: Senior asks: a client sends {"price": 10.0, "qty": 2} to write on a .json file. The API decodes it and saves it again. What is in the file (compact)?
explain: json_decode makes price a float. json_encode writes a float with no decimals as 10, unless you pass JSON_PRESERVE_ZERO_FRACTION. So 10.0 becomes 10 in the file. For money this is a reason to store cents as int or the price as a string.
